name: Grid / List View Toggle
summary: Fixed Grid/List collection-mode profile over canonical native Segmented Control with visible icon-plus-text choices, one value, logical arrow navigation, and target-owned result coordination.

behavior.name: canonicalSegmentedComposition
behavior.description: E5 is a profile of canonical Segmented Control and does not duplicate its selection, focus, validation, disabled, forced-color, or reduced-motion implementation.

behavior.name: fixedNativeChoice
behavior.description: Exactly two same-name native Radios in stable Grid/List source order own one value, one Tab entry point, logical directional selection, events, FormData, and reset.

behavior.name: visibleIconAndText
behavior.description: Every segment combines one fixed passive icon with complete visible localized text. Text alone communicates the value.

behavior.name: defaultAndAvailability
behavior.description: Grid is the neutral initial value unless a target explicitly supplies a valid merchant, URL, or account preference. Omit E5 whenever only one real result layout exists.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
behavior.description: One group value is the only current-view owner. Static/uncontrolled targets author one initial checked Radio; framework adapters project one activeView and one callback.

behavior.name: resultOwnership
behavior.description: The target result coordinator applies Grid/List while preserving filters, sort, pagination, product identity, and focus/scroll according to target policy. Neutral E5 stores nothing and emits no live announcement.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: The two horizontal segments share available inline space; visible localized labels wrap without hiding icons or changing fixed source order at narrow widths, RTL, zoom, or user text spacing.

behavior.name: noNeutralRuntime
behavior.description: E5 adds no listener, observer, timer, request, storage, formatter, layout read, animation coordinator, result mutation, or component-specific JavaScript; native Radios own interaction.

accessibility: Use the canonical native Segmented Control Fieldset, a visible Legend, and exactly two same-name native Radios with fixed grid and list values; do not add redundant radiogroup, radio, aria-pressed, or button semantics.
Keep exactly one checked value. Grid is the neutral default unless a target supplies another valid initial preference; omit E5 when only one real layout exists.
Let native Radio behavior provide one Tab entry point, logical arrow selection, Space, input/change, FormData, disabled propagation, and reset.
Keep Grid and List as complete visible localized text. Hide their redundant decorative icons and never rely on icon, color, position, or selected surface alone.
Keep keyboard focus visually distinct from selected state through canonical Segmented Control; do not move focus to results automatically.
Preserve 44px minimum targets, visible text at effective 200 percent, user text spacing, RTL, dark mode, reduced motion, forced colors, and narrow-container wrapping.
Neutral E5 does not announce view changes. A target may update one pre-existing localized result status only when the result change is meaningful and not already announced.

web.notes: Canonical Segmented Control fieldset/radios plus fixed E5 icon/text composition; target results and preference lifecycle remain consumer-owned and E5 adds zero runtime.

shopify.notes: Requires an owning collection section, visible localized labels, result-mode mapping, merchant/default policy, optional URL/persistence coordination, editor behavior, and live-store proof.

react.notes: The shared docs renderer projects one activeView to canonical Segmented Control and emits one value change; a distributable adapter may also expose defaultValue.
